svg.text: Where each question travels — every route is inspectable, deterministic and evidence-carrying
impact walks two extra stations: OKF (YANG family → NB entries → callbacks) then memo-cache — that is why it is the only 3-digit lane
every lane returns the same shape: typed entities · routed intent · answer · per-item evidence (rel + tag + src_ref file:line) · fingerprint
